title: Game Bundle
description: A single versioned, privacy-reviewed export of the direct-ancestor subset of the tree, built for game consumption (web slice today, eventual Godot build). Generated by tools/build_game_bundle.py from data/people/, data/journeys/, and docs/research/. Never hand-edited — re-run the generator after source records change. This is a separate artifact from the core person/journey schemas: it does not alter or gate the main ANC data pipeline.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp when the bundle was generated.

generated_at_source_commit.description: Git commit hash of the ANC checkout the bundle was built from, for reproducibility. Null if the checkout was dirty or commit info was unavailable.

home_person_id.description: The GEDCOM (or manual M-prefixed) id the ancestor walk starts from.

source_provenance.description: One entry per distinct ANC source cited by any included person, classified for redistribution/licensing purposes.

duplicate_clusters.description: Groups of person ids the generator believes refer to the same real individual, for visibility even though each person's own canonical_id/duplicate_of fields already encode the resolution.

basis.description: manual-research = confirmed during hand research (see that person's manual.notes); name-and-birth-year-heuristic = same normalized name + birth year, unreviewed.

generation.description: Generations back from the home person (0 = home person, 1 = parents, 2 = grandparents, ...).

side.description: Which of the home person's two gen-1 parents this ancestor descends through. 'self' only for generation 0. 'unknown' if the walk reached this person by more than one path or the split point is ambiguous (e.g. pedigree collapse).

lineage_path.description: Ancestor names from the home person down to (and including) this person, generation by generation. UI breadcrumb / branch-identification material.

privacy_status.description: public_safe = has a recorded death year, safe to use in-game as-is. possibly_living = no death year and (no birth year, or born after ~1935) - heuristic, needs human confirmation before use. living_confirmed = known to be alive (the home person and their parents, hardcoded).

content_readiness.description: not_ready = no journey file, or a seeded journey with no narrative text. draft = has some narrative text but journey.status is not yet 'reviewed'. ready = journey.status is 'reviewed' and every waypoint has narrative text.

readiness_score.description: 0-100 composite: journey existence, status tier, waypoint count, narrative coverage, and documented-vs-inferred-vs-legend confidence mix. For sorting/prioritizing which ancestors are closest to game-ready, not a precise metric.

canonical_id.description: This person's own id if they are the canonical record, or the id of the record they duplicate. Game code should always look up by canonical_id.

usage_note.description: Human-readable guidance on what the game may do with facts drawn from this source.
